AboutUs.impact_description: The Local Action Group "Stejarul Dacilor" actively contributes to the development of rural communities in the Cimișlia-Căușeni districts by supporting local initiatives. Through the projects we support, we contribute to the economic, social, and cultural development of villages, the valorization of resources, and cooperation between communities. We aim for more prosperous villages, better connected and future-oriented – through active involvement, innovative ideas, and efficient use of resources for the benefit of the people.
